ROOT CAUSE:
The snippet failed with a `cannot find symbol` error because it incorrectly assumed `ThumbnailParameterBuilder` is in the root `net.coobird.thumbnailator` package. The builder is actually located in `net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder`. Furthermore, the snippet attempted to guess the packages for `Region` and `AbsoluteSize`, which likely also caused resolution failures.

CORRECT USAGE:
```java
net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.BufferedImageSource source = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.BufferedImageSource(sourceImage);

net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder()
    .size(20, 20)
    .build();

source.setThumbnailParameter(param);
```
